visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A group of five people (three men and two women) are in a bright white studio. They are wearing white shirts and laughing. The wall behind them is white with several headshot portraits and logos of a blue whale. Large yellow text overlays are prominently displayed in the center. (2) The scene transitions to a game format where participants sit on chairs. The man standing in the center acts as a host. People clap rhythmically and gesture with their hands while smiling and looking at the camera. (3) Close-ups of individual participants show them thinking hard and then shouting answers. When a mistake is made, the screen shakes and the surrounding group reacts with exaggerated expressions of frustration and amusement. (4) A product unboxing/showcase transition shows a red milk tea carton against a white background with radial motion lines. Two men then hold the product cartons up, tapping them together. (5) The final scene shows the whole group laughing together while multiple product variants are displayed as graphic overlays on the screen.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with high-intensity collective shouting of a single syllable, accompanied by sharp, rhythmic handclapping that provides a percussive foundation. An upbeat, high-tempo electronic beat starts immediately. (2) Vocal narration follows at a fast pace. Every rhythmic cycle is marked by loud claps and foot stomps. A high-pitched ding sound effect occurs as players successfully answer. The music features a simple, driving synthesizer melody. (3) When a participant makes a comedic error, the music stops abruptly with a record-scratch effect, followed by loud collective laughter and exaggerated vocal complaints from multiple speakers. (4) The track resumes with higher energy. Rhythmic clapping continues under quick-fire dialogue. Fast-paced Mandarin speech dominates the mix. (5) In the final segment, the rhythmic clapping stops, replaced by a polished commercial jingle with a warm synth bass. A male voice delivers a rhythmic slogan in a deep, rhythmic tone: 'U know I 濃'.
